 Let's all take a moment to stare at the SEC standings.
 Drew Franklin @ DrewFranklinKSR 33m 0 Share Share 
 Big Blue Nation, let’s all take a moment to look at the SEC standings. Let’s not just look, though. Let’s stare. Take it all in. Maybe screenshot them and send them to your friends and family, although they should be staring at the standings right now, too.
 Because this is uncharted territory for Kentucky fans. The Wildcats sit all alone at the top of the Southeastern Conference. This is real life, not a drill or a fever dream.
 After beating Vanderbilt, your University of Kentucky Wildcats are 7-1 overall and 5-1 in league play, riding six straight victories. Georgia (we’ve heard of them) is next at 4-1, followed by Alabama (heard of them, too) at 4-2. Everyone else in the conference has at least two SEC losses.
 We’re heading into the final week of October, and Will Stein’s Kentucky Wildcats are looking down at the rest of the league.
 Go ahead. Stare a little longer. It’s real. I promise. You’re not dreaming.
